about.label: About
about.title: Curious by nature, obsessive about the details.
about.p1: I got into web design out of plain curiosity and turned it into a profession. Today I run my own projects as an entrepreneur and design websites for businesses across Romania.
about.p2: I care about the parts people feel but rarely notice: how fast a page loads, how the type sits, how a button responds. I want the sites I build to leave a lasting impression and to do their job.
